स ind. A prefix substituted for
सह or सम्, सम, तुल्य, or सदृश and एक
or समान, and compounded with
nouns to form adjectives and
adverbs in the sense of (a) with,
together with, along with,
accompanied by, having, possessed of;
सपुत्र, सभार्य, सतृष्ण, सधन, सरोषं,
सकोपं, सहरि &c.; (b) similar, like;
सधर्मन् ‘of a similar nature’; so
सजाति, सवर्ण; (c) same; सोदर, सपक्ष,
सपिंड, सनाभि &c. --m.
